title: Harvard plates (1889-1990) confirm ASAS-3/TESS period changes of southern detached binaries, but light travel time from a third star of at most the binary mass fails for 7-9 of the 18 largest
abstract: SCI 02d77ae9 found common-mode period changes between ASAS-3 (2000-2009) and TESS (2018-2026) eclipse times in 77 of 304 detached southern binaries (P = 5-22 d) and proposed third stars on decade orbits (light-travel-time effect, LTTE) as the cause. We tested this with fully independent data: Harvard DASCH plates of 1889-1990. A template fit with permutation and bootstrap tests measured the mean plate period of all 304 binaries; the plates detect the eclipses in 271. The plate period differs from the TESS period by more than 3 sigma in 30 of 67 common-mode binaries but in 10 of 194 quiet binaries of the same sample (Fisher p = 7e-13; errors include a split-half factor of 1.52). The quiet binaries show no common timing bias (median velocity-equivalent offset +0.04 km/s). The plate offsets correlate with the ASAS-3 offsets (Spearman 0.40, p = 0.0009) but are near 0.3 of them, not 4.7 as a constant period derivative predicts, so the periods vary up and down. A Monte Carlo with the real sampling shows that LTTE from third stars with m3 <= M12 explains the plate periods of about 51 of 66 binaries, but 15 are outside the central 98 percent (1.3 expected). Century O-C diagrams of the 18 strongest cases favour 40-200-year LTTE over a constant period derivative, but a mass limit m3 <= M12 (sin i = 1) rejects LTTE for 9 (connected O-C) or 7 (free plate offset) binaries, which need velocity changes of 10-45 km/s. These changes need dark massive companions or a cause other than light travel time. Limits: logbook time stamps, an ASAS-3 V template on blue plates, half-period aliases across 1990-2000, TIC-based masses, no spectroscopy.

display.caption: Plate (1889-1990) minus TESS period for common-mode-change and quiet binaries; plate against ASAS-3 period offsets with the no-change, stationary-LTTE and constant-dP/dt expectations; velocity-equivalent offsets by group.

O-C diagrams 1889-2026 (Harvard plates, ASAS-3, TESS) of the 18 strongest common-mode binaries with free-mass LTTE and constant-dP/dt fits; titles give the scaled Delta chi-square of the third-star mass limit m3 <= M12.
Controls: split-half calibration of plate period errors, stacked plate-era timing offsets, and plate period offsets of 194 quiet binaries.
